_comment: Content pin for the generated LLO execution/v1 MCP contract artifact.
Update the source commit and digest together when LLO publishes a new contract.
sourceCommit MUST be a commit reachable from a published tag, not a branch tip.
This pin previously named 2835bdce — a commit on LLO's integration branch, which
PR #317 squash-merged into main. It is NOT an ancestor of v0.15.0, so the bytes
this artifact claimed to come from were already unreachable from any released
history and would vanish entirely when the branch was deleted. A content pin
whose source cannot be fetched is a digest with no provenance: it still detects
cloister-side corruption, but it can no longer answer `where did this come from`,
which is the question the pin exists to answer.
REGENERATING (needs an LLO checkout; cloister CI deliberately has none):
2. from <llo>/rs/ll-core/schema-spec at the tag named by sourceCommit:
Step 1 matters: the generator must itself come from the digest-verified path.
The v0.15.0 re-vendor was first done with a hand-downloaded binary, which is the
same unverified-input shape the schema-bridge lock exists to prevent.
